title: Bluereader doesn't show predictive simulations?
symptom: The user reports that the Bolus Wizard Preview (predictive simulations) does not appear on the main page even after setting Carb Ratio, Insulin Sensitivity, and CHO Absorption Rate. Additionally, the BlueReader battery values on the main page have a black contour making them almost unreadable.
cause: The predictive simulation not showing was due to a missing setting: 'Always show Bolus Wizard Preview' was not enabled. The black contour issue was not definitively resolved; it was speculated to be related to the user's font size set to 'Very large' and possibly a modified DPI, but no root cause was confirmed.
fix: Enable the setting: Settings -> xDrip+ Display Settings -> Always show Bolus Wizard Preview. For the battery text readability, no fix was provided in the thread.
settings_changed: Always show Bolus Wizard Preview → ON
evidence_quote: Try: `Settings` -> `xDrip+ Display Settings` -> `Always show Bolus Wizard Preview`
